'''Wind''' is the name of a wolf in [[Dapple]]'s pack.

==Activities==
Wind, along with Dapple, [[Hopper]], and [[Burn]], interacted with [[Elyas Machera]] and [[Perrin Aybara]] when Perrin was first learning about being a [[wolfbrother]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Wind(2)|Wind}}{{ref/book|1|23}} He accompanied the group as they traveled and became reluctant when the humans stopped to visit with [[Tuatha'an|Tinkers]].{{ref/book|1|25}}{{ref/book|1|27}} When flocks of ravens later track and attack the humans, Wind was injured when a raven punctured his left foreleg.{{ref||Wind}}{{ref/book|1|29}}
